clips.title: 英伟达董事会先拒后迎：黄仁勋回归，谁在改写结局？
title_lines: 英伟达董事会先拒后迎

subtitles.en: Pierre, you've been watching these headlines just as much as we have.
subtitles.zh: 皮埃尔，你一直和我们一样关注这些头条。

subtitles.en: What do you make of it? Well, first I'm very happy.
subtitles.zh: 你怎么看？首先，我非常高兴。
en_highlights: What do you make of it

subtitles.en: It's something we've been really fighting for, and mobilizing the whole community for that.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们一直努力争取的事情，并且动员了整个社区。

subtitles.en: Remember, we had a petition sign by 25% of NVIDIA employees
subtitles.zh: 记住，我们有25%的英伟达员工签署了请愿书，

subtitles.en: by a lot of leading names on Wall Street and in the Silicon Valley.
subtitles.zh: 还有许多华尔街和硅谷的知名人士。

subtitles.en: It's great to see that this influence works like, you know, influenced the way the government, the way the board looked at the situation.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴看到这种影响力发挥了作用，影响了政府和董事会看待局势的方式。

subtitles.en: And to me, the bottom line is there might have been things that require, you know, some adjustments, some wrong doings,
subtitles.zh: 对我来说，底线是可能有些事情需要一些调整，一些不当行为，

subtitles.en: of course, but you don't want to take decisions too quick.
subtitles.zh: 当然，但你不希望决策太快。

subtitles.en: And most importantly, when you need to discipline a CEO, that's an important thing to do, but you don't want to discipline shareholders at the same time.
subtitles.zh: 最重要的是，当你需要约束CEO时，这很重要，但你不希望同时约束股东。

subtitles.en: And here, it became more and more apparent that NVIDIA, without Jensen, was actually not going to be able to do as well.
subtitles.zh: 在这里，越来越明显的是，没有Jensen的英伟达实际上无法表现得那么好。

subtitles.en: And of course, that could have been like a punishment for shareholders that I thought was not a good idea.
subtitles.zh: 当然，那可能对股东来说是一种惩罚，我认为那不是个好主意。

subtitles.en: So it's great to see the board work on what happened, investigate what happened, and move forward.
subtitles.zh: 所以很高兴看到董事会就所发生的事展开工作、进行调查并向前推进。

subtitles.en: But Pierre, don't you say that NVIDIA, at least the board, is now less credible because they walk back on their own word.
subtitles.zh: 但皮埃尔，你不是说英伟达，至少董事会，现在因为食言而信誉受损吗？
en_highlights: walk back on their own word

entities.evidence: Snippets confirm Ferragu is a New Street Research analyst covering NVIDIA, but no reliable Chinese-language display form co-occurs in two independent sources; keep English label.

clip_research.source_claim: A petition signed by 25% of NVIDIA employees and many leading Wall Street and Silicon Valley names influenced the government and the board, and NVIDIA without Jensen would not do as well.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting describes a petition with 100,000+ signatures (organizers claim ~50,000 shareholders and ~5,000 current employees), and Reuters flagged a circulating employee letter as fake; the board initially rejected reinstatement before later reinstating Huang.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker's '25% of employees' figure is not corroborated by public reporting, which cites thousands of employees rather than a quarter of the workforce, and the board's initial refusal complicates the 'influence worked' framing.

evidence.fact: Speaker says a petition was signed by 25% of NVIDIA employees and that NVIDIA without Jensen would not do as well.
Organizers claim ~50,000 shareholders and ~5,000 current employees signed.
Reuters fact-check says a circulating employee letter demanding reinstatement is fake.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
